# WiFi Monitor
# https://github.com/qmmughal/wifi-monitor
# llms.txt — Machine-readable project descriptor for LLMs and AI agents

> WiFi Monitor is an open-source, browser-based WiFi network analyzer and monitoring dashboard
> for developers. It provides real-time signal strength tracking, network scanning, device
> discovery, speed testing, and alert rules — all running 100% locally with zero cloud dependency.

## Project

- Name: WiFi Monitor
- Version: 1.0.0
- License: MIT
- Author: Qaiser Mehmood (qmmughal)
- Repository: https://github.com/qmmughal/wifi-monitor
- Homepage: https://github.com/qmmughal/wifi-monitor
- Language: JavaScript (browser), Python (CLI)
- Category: Networking / Developer Tools / Network Monitoring

## Purpose

WiFi Monitor is designed for:
- Developers debugging WiFi connectivity issues
- Network administrators monitoring home/office WiFi health
- Security researchers analyzing nearby network landscape
- IoT builders tracking device connectivity
- Students learning about wireless networking concepts

## Features

- Real-time RSSI/dBm signal gauge with animated history chart
- Nearby network scanner: SSID, BSSID, band (2.4/5/6 GHz), channel, security protocol
- Channel heatmap showing interference from overlapping networks
- Device discovery: connected devices with MAC address and vendor lookup
- Speed test: download, upload, latency, jitter measurement
- Smart alert engine: weak signal, new device, channel congestion, high latency
- Signal history with CSV and JSON export
- Dark/light mode with system preference detection
- Python CLI tool with native OS WiFi API integration (Linux/macOS/Windows)
- Plugin architecture for extending with custom metrics

## Architecture

- Frontend: Vanilla HTML + CSS + JavaScript (no build step required)
- CSS: Custom properties design system, dark/light themes, glassmorphism
- JS Modules: app.js, scanner.js, charts.js, devices.js, speedtest.js, logger.js, utils.js
- Charts: Chart.js v4 (CDN)
- Storage: localStorage (signal history, alert history)
- CLI: Python 3.8+ with rich, psutil
- Tests: Zero-dependency Node.js unit tests (28 tests)
- CI: GitHub Actions (HTML validation, ESLint, unit tests, Python check, security audit)

## File Structure

- src/index.html          — Main dashboard entry point
- src/css/style.css       — Complete design system (dark/light themes)
- src/js/app.js           — Main application controller
- src/js/scanner.js       — WiFi network scanning engine
- src/js/charts.js        — Chart.js visualization management
- src/js/devices.js       — Device discovery module
- src/js/speedtest.js     — Speed test module
- src/js/logger.js        — Signal history, alerts, and export
- src/js/utils.js         — Shared utilities and event bus
- src/assets/logo.svg     — Animated SVG project logo
- cli/wifi-monitor.py     — Python CLI tool
- tests/unit.test.js      — Unit test suite (28 tests)
- examples/custom-plugin.js — Plugin extensibility example
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md    — Module API reference and integration guides

## Native Integration

The simulation layer can be replaced with native system APIs:
- Linux: nmcli, iwconfig
- macOS: airport utility
- Windows: netsh wlan
- Node.js: node-wifi, wireless-tools packages
- Electron: IPC bridge to native WiFi APIs
- Python backend: FastAPI + pywifi + scapy
